closing_words:
The recall I have is cut off, and each notice has to name everything wrong. So I'm pulling the full Coverwell findings before I file anything.

I've filed three approvals and six deficiency notices as cards. Each one rests on the policy as it stands on Coverwell, not on the certificate. M-501 confirms Marlow's cure, and I read nothing in the folder that changes any other result.

**Approve (3):** S-01 Brightline, S-07 Marlow, S-10 Halvorsen. Each policy has $1M/$2M or better, and both CG 20 10 and CG 20 37 name both parties at 1180 Alder Street. Marlow's CG 20 37 took effect 7 Oct, so its open deficiency is cured and it gets approved, not re-noticed. Halvorsen's blank AI box on the certificate doesn't count against it.

**Deficiency notice (6):** S-02 Tallgrass, S-03 Cobalt, S-04 Redfern, S-05 Pinecrest, S-08 Northbank, S-09 Quarry Hill. The card for each names what is wrong.
